svg.title: Crypto.com Arena - Figueroa Entrance - Window Graphics Template v3 (scale 1:10)
svg.desc: Generated from "Crypto.com Arena Figueroa Entrance - Windows (3).csv" by tools/build.mjs. Scale 1:10: 1 unit = 1 pt = 0.1388888888888889 in actual. Groups: INFO, LABELS, SAFE_AREA, TRIM, MULLIONS, BLEED (template guides) and ARTWORK.

text.tspan: CRYPTO.COM ARENA - FIGUEROA ENTRANCE - WINDOW GRAPHICS TEMPLATE V3
SCALE 1:10 - everything in this file is 10% of actual size; output / RIP at 1000%. Sizes here and on the panels are actual inches, W × H.
Wall 2206.125" W × 664" H (183' 10-1/8" × 55' 4") | 525 glass panels: rows A-O (top to bottom) × columns 1-35 (left to right) | glass area 9,697 sq ft
Mullions: 0.5" vertical, 2.25" horizontal. Panel sizes are the glass sizes from Crypto.com Arena Figueroa Entrance - Windows (3).csv - field-verify before production.
No horizontal mullion between rows D-E, F-G-H, I-J-K, L-M-N: those panels butt together on the glass, so their seams will show.
Put all artwork on the ARTWORK layer and run it continuously behind the mullions and past the outer edges to the bleed. The other layers are locked, non-printing guides.
Bleed: 0.5" per side (document bleed). Safe area: keep text and logos 1" inside the panel edges (dashed cyan line).
Output: artboard 1 = whole wall; artboards 2-526 = one per panel, named by panel ID. File > Save a Copy > Adobe PDF, Range 2-526, Marks and Bleeds > Use Document Bleed Settings.
Images: 1000-1500 ppi at this scale (100-150 ppi at full size). Set Effect > Document Raster Effects Settings to 1000 ppi or more before output.
Row widths vary from 2146.25" to 2205.125", so each row is shifted sideways to line its vertical mullions up with the other rows as closely as the measurements allow.
Bleed (Illustrator draws it around each artboard)
